title: 流体力学
subtitle: Fluid Dynamics
keywords: Viscous fluid 2.Conservation law 3.Turbulent flow 4.CFD 5.Contribution to local community
educationalGoal: Students will acquire a basic ability for theoretical analysis of actual events related to fluid dynamics. Through exercises using CFD, students will predict the flow field and experience the actual flow analysis method. In addition, will deepen their understanding of advanced technology and problems to be solved related to regional thermal and fluid dynamics.
advice: Classes will be conducted with emphasis on understanding of engineering and physical meaning. The following items will be practices as the basis of actual fluid motion: 1. Fluid dynamics overview 2. Conservation law, continuous equation, Navier-Stokes equation, and energy equation 3. Turbulent flow, Reynolds stress, and Prandtl mixing distance theory 4. Numerical analysis and CFD exercises 5. Comprehensive exercises for the regional community
books: Textbooks: (in Japanese) Reference books: Reserved books:
requiredKnowledge: Completion of Industrial Mechanics I and II. Acquisition of basic hydrostatic knowledge learned in Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics I and II.

activityGoals.body: Be able to analyze fluid phenomena theoretically.
Be able to understand the conservation law and apply it to fluid phenomena.
Be able to model viscous fluid phenomena theoretically.
Be able to simulate fluid phenomena using CFD.
Be able to investigate comprehensive problems that can contribute to the community.
Be able to discuss issues and outcomes actively.

achievementLevels.ideal: Understand that fluid phenomena are governed by the basic equation of mechanics, and viscosity-related fluid phenomena, especially flow in pipes can be completely realized. Completely explain the mechanism of fluid loss and calculate the flow in the pipe. Understand the approximations and problems in fluid phenomena modeling when using basic equations. Understand problems related to the local community, evaluate related flow phenomena using CFD and other methods, and explain applications regarding flow phenomena scientifically and essentially.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand that fluid phenomena are governed by the basic equations of mechanics, and explain and develop methods of the induction of the basic equation of viscosity related fluid phenomena, especially equations of the flow in a pipe. Understand the approximations and problems in fluid phenomena when using basic equations. Understand problems in the community, and easily explain related flow phenomena and the application of CFD and other methods. Actively participate in questions and answers and also in essential discussions.

lessons.content: Review the course policy, purpose, and outline,and understand the educational goal and achievement level of this subject. Detailed schedule will be explained in the first lecture.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents learned in Fundamental Fluid Mechanics I and II through questions on taken during the course.

lessons.content: Learn about conservation laws and continuity equations derived from them.
lessons.assignments: Read pp. 44-46 of the textbook carefully. Review Euler’s equations of motion learned during Fluid Mechanics I and implementation of designated preparatory note tasks. Review class content.

lessons.content: Learn about Euler's equation and Navier-Stokes equation.
lessons.assignments: Read pp. 46-50 of the textbook. Preparatory note on Navier-Stokes equations. Review exercises. Review class content. Understand the meaning of Euler's equations of motion and Navier-Stokes equations
Read pp. 48-50 of the textbook. Review exercises. Review class content.

lessons.content: Learn about turbulence phenomena, especially about Reynolds stress and the Prandtl mixing length theory.
lessons.assignments: Read pp. 97-99 of the textbook. Preparatory note on shear stress, Reynolds stress, and turbulent flow. Review class content.

lessons.content: Through the exam, confirm your level of understanding of lecture content. Review and self-check your understanding.
Understand problems related to flow phenomena in the local community and the potential of CFD for problem solving.
lessons.assignments: Propose issues to solve using CFD.

lessons.content: Learn basic knowledge of CFD and turbulence models.
Learn principles and methods through CFD exercises.
CFD exercise on flow in a pipe and around a body.
lessons.operation: CFD exercise about flow in an orifice

lessons.content: CFD exercise on flow in a pipe and around a body.
lessons.operation: CFD exercise about flow around a car

lessons.content: CFD exercise on problems that students choose themselves.
